title: Translate entire app UI from English to Hindi

requirements.summary: Translate all user-facing text in the Navigation component into Hindi
acceptanceCriteria: All desktop nav link labels are displayed in Hindi
All mobile menu labels are displayed in Hindi
Admin link text is displayed in Hindi
No English text remains visible in the Navigation component

file_operations.description: Replace all English text with Hindi translations including nav link labels (Home → होम, About → हमारे बारे में, Programs → कार्यक्रम, Philosophy → दर्शन, Resources → संसाधन, Contact → संपर्क करें, Donate → दान करें), mobile menu labels, and admin link text (Admin → प्रबंधन). Preserve all component structure, styling, routing paths, and conditional admin link logic.
